final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ordersmark AS ref, AVG(remaincount) AS gavg FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS savg FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ref AS ref, s1.gavg AS gavg, s1.gavg - s2.savg AS diff FROM s1 CROSS JOIN s2 WHERE s2.savg IS NOT NULL AND s1.gavg > s2.savg), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS savg FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.ref AS ref, s3.gavg AS gavg, s3.diff AS diff, s3.gavg - s4.savg AS diff2 FROM s3 CROSS JOIN s4 WHERE s4.savg IS NOT NULL AND s3.gavg > s4.savg) SELECT AVG(gavg), AVG(diff), AVG(diff2) FROM s5
